identity: A green-red aggro deck that treats domain as a stat multiplier on cheap bodies rather than as a ramp target. Twelve of the twenty-four nonland cards cost one mana and only two cost three, so the deck makes a turn-one play in 68% of games and a turn-two play in 94% (tapland-aware measurement - see deployment_measured). Nishoba Brawler is a two-mana trampler whose power is the basic land type count, Sunbathing Rootwalla converts flooded mana into the same scaling, and Gaea's Might is a one-mana pump worth +3/+3 on the turn it matters. It is honestly a DOMAIN 3 deck, not a domain 4 or 5 one: the measured curve is 75% to three types by turn three and 43% to four by turn five, and Plains is unreachable entirely, because every typed dual enters tapped and an aggressive deck cannot pay for more than seven of them.

sideboard.name: Broken Wings
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
sideboard.when_to_board: The answer to the maindeck's stated coverage concession. 'Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying' covers three classes at once against a cube holding 15 artifacts, 18 enchantments and 51 evasion cards. It is a three-mana card in a deck whose curve tops at three, which is exactly why it boards in rather than starts.

sideboard.name: Bite Down
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against creature decks with a single large blocker. 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power' is priced off Nishoba Brawler at 3-4 power or a Gaea's Might-pumped body, so it kills far above its two-mana cost.

sideboard.name: Smash to Dust
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target artifact.
• Destroy target creature with defender.
• Smash to Dust deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against artifacts, and against go-wide token decks: the third mode 'deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control' sweeps x/1s while leaving this deck's own board untouched, which the maindeck has no way to do.

sideboard.name: Snarespinner
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach
Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fliers. 'Reach | Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0' is a two-mana 1/3 that blocks as a 3/3 - two mana earlier than a Magnigoth Sentry, which matters in a deck whose whole curve tops at three.

sideboard.name: Llanowar Greenwidow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach, trample
Domain — {7}{G}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." This ability costs {1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fliers and against the cube's six sweepers. A {2}{G} 4/3 with reach and trample blocks the air and attacks on the ground, and its domain-discounted recursion returns it from the graveyard, so a wrath does not permanently answer it. This is the fifth and final rare slot.

sideboard.name: Coalition Warbrute
sideboard.oracle_text:
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
Trample
sideboard.when_to_board: In against decks that block profitably on the ground. A 3/4 trample for four with enlist converts a spare untapped attacker's power into trample damage, which the maindeck's one- and two-drops cannot do once the board clogs.

sideboard.name: Meria's Outrider
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach
Domain — When this creature enters, it deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against the cube's 22-card lifegain class, which is the matchup that beats a turn-6 clock. 'Domain - When this creature enters, it deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control' is 3 damage at this deck's measured domain 3 that does not need to connect, on a 4/4 reach body that also blocks the 51-card evasion class. Five mana is past the maindeck curve, which is exactly why it is a sideboard card.
